summary: Hotel101 Global Holdings Corp. (NASDAQ: HBNB), a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a 6-K attaching a November 2, 2026 press release announcing record October operating results for its 680-room Hotel101-Madrid property: €2.93 million (approximately US$3.28 million) of monthly recurring stay revenue at 97.41% average occupancy. No transaction, shareholder action, or capital event is disclosed. The release describes unit-owner economics (30% of net gross room revenue distributed monthly) and management's intent to pursue joint ventures and future licensing. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
